pro_course_detail.title: Everyday English for Daily Life
pro_course_detail.description:
1. The first part of class we will warm up by looking at a picture and pretend to be in a setting from everyday life and discussing the 5 Ws (Who, What, When, Where, Why) of what we see in the picture. You will make phrases and I will give you feedback to help correct pronunciation and grammar. This part of the lesson is designed to give you a chance to learn and practice new vocabulary and phrases when you are outside and observing what is going on around you. You will start to think in English. 

2. The next part of the lesson we will use materials that include a combination of Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing activities. These will include PDFs, Videos, Quizzes and Discussion topics for you to use in your interactions with English speakers. The materials will be adjusted to your level and learning objectives.

3. The last part of the lesson will include a cultural component. This could be music and song lyrics, news videos or information about places to visit in an English speaking country.  This is a fun part of the lesson but also very important because language connects us as people, and making connections in business, work or socially is the goal of interacting with anyone.

With all lessons, you can choose if you want to focus more on a specific part or topic and I will design the lessons so you can make progress on your English journey and use what you learn in class.

Learn how the exams are assessed and get tips on how to deal with common problems learners have while preparing.  
A series of classes is recommended to make the most of your preparation time and to perfect your skills.
